newsitem.title: UK: DTI asked to investigate William Cook - FT.
newsitem.headline: DTI asked to investigate William Cook - FT.

text.p: The UK's Department of Trade and Industry has been asked to investigate discrepancies between a trading statement by steel castings firm William Cook and information it gave its bankers, the Financial Times said.
The FT said Andrew Cook, chairman and chief executive of William Cook, confirmed a request had been lodged at the DTI.
Cook claimed, however, that the request was an attempt by rival engineering group Triplex Lloyd to destabilise William Cook's defence against a hostile takeover bid from Triplex, the FT said.
Earlier this week, a management buyout team spearheaded by Cook himself an launched offer document for William Cook, confirming its desire to stave off the bid from Triplex.
